liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **California Earthquake** (5 reviews): Reviewer treats the opening California Earthquake as the show's highlight, noting it was played only twice; Reviewer singles out California Earthquake as the first-set opener and the main reason to hear the show [21][22][24][25][29]
- **Looks Like Rain** (2 reviews): Reviewer praises the second-set opening run of Touch Of Grey, Looks Like Rain and We Can Run; Reviewer counts Looks Like Rain, along with California Earthquake and We Can Run, as the good moments [29][31]
- **Bertha** (1 review): Reviewer finds the first set tame until Bertha, when the band becomes more active [26]
- **We Can Run** (1 review): Brent forgot the words at the start, and a lyric sheet had to be brought out, though it recovered [28]
- **Feel Like A Stranger** (1 review): Reviewer calls Feel Like A Stranger pretty hot [29]
- **Let It Grow** (1 review): Reviewer finds Let It Grow bad, saying nothing fits together [31]
- **Attics Of My Life** (1 other source): Attics Of My Life was the encore [1]

## The recordings

- **gd1989-10-23.142577.fob.schoeps.cmc4.mk4.mattes.miller.clugston.flac1648** (recommended): audience recording; 23 songs; 176 min [1]
- **gd1989-10-23.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.83327.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 169 min; rated 3.14/5 by 7 [3]
- **gd1989-10-23.148155.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 172 min [4]
- **gd1989-10-23.147916.mtx.tobin.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 167 min [6]
- **gd89-10-23.sbd.jeffm.2223.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 164 min; rated 4.08/5 by 24 [14]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the soundboard recording sounds great; Mix is solid with every instrument well represented; a minor hiss, possibly from FM, is present; Reviewer rates the recording's sound quality as very good [21][24][25][28]

## Around the show

- A tape flip falls at the end of Terrapin Station, right before Drums [3]
- A poster says they drove from NY to Charlotte for the show [36]
- Video footage from the Charlotte show appeared on YouTube [37]
- Reviewer ranks this among the best shows of 1989 [22]
- Reviewer finds the show lackluster despite coming from a good run of shows [30]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1989-10-23.142577.fob.schoeps.cmc4.mk4.mattes.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Ted Mattes; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: flac16/48kHz ; Source Info: Ted Mattes' Master (FOB)Audience Dat; Schoeps CMC4/MK4 mics @ 110 degrees, ORTF, Schoeps t-bar, hand held, chin high > Monster… [1]
- **gd1989-10-23.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.83327.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG90) D [3]. Also: Tapes came from Paul Scotton and Joani Walker [3]
- **gd1989-10-23.148155.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG90) [4]. Also: Two sets of masters were combined to make the show complete [4]
- **gd1989-10-23.147916.mtx.tobin.flac16**: transferred by SBD + AUD Matrix 2 Source Mix (44/16) by Kevin Tobin; source: SBD + AUD Matrix 2 Source Mix (44/16) [6]. Also: This is a mix made by an archive.org user, converted to FLAC in November 2019 [6]
- **gd89-10-23.sbd.jeffm.2223.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD> DAT> Sonic Solutions> CD> FM> DAT> CDR> EAC> SHN [14]. Also: Reviewer's older copy of the first set came from a taper named Steve and was chopped and spliced [27]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Kirsten Michel: [1989-10-23 Charlotte Coliseum, Charlotte, NC, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1989-10-23-charlotte-coliseum-charlotte-nc-usa/) [38]
- Poster by Kirsten Michel: [1989-10-23 Charlotte Coliseum, Charlotte, NC, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1989-10-23-charlotte-coliseum-charlotte-nc-usa/) [39]

Reviewer ranks this among the best shows of 1989
Reviewer notes California Earthquake opens the show and was the last time it was played

Reviewer finds the band tired and sloppy, with rough vocals, but sees California Earthquake as a novelty
Reviewer rates the recording's sound quality as very good
Reviewer finds the first set tame until Bertha, when the band becomes more active
Reviewer's older copy of the first set came from a taper named Steve and was chopped and spliced

Reviewer says the sound is great
